criteria.name: Runnable application and complete game flow
criteria.reason: Entry file is only the infrastructure comment; independent modules are never imported or initialized.

criteria.name: Circuit, scenery and environmental presentation
criteria.reason: Track/ground/marking outlines exist, but checkpoint mapping references out-of-scope p and the road tube is rotated vertically.

criteria.name: Differentiated selectable vehicles
criteria.reason: Three colored specification sets and body/cabin/wheel geometry exist in unused modules; no car choices are displayed or used.

criteria.name: Keyboard driving and handling
criteria.reason: Unused Vehicle has acceleration, reverse, friction and speed-influenced steering; no keyboard input is connected.

criteria.name: Independent interacting NPC opponents
criteria.reason: Unused waypoint steering and speed adjustment exist, but targeting shares the lap checkpoint index and lacks traffic, passing, collisions or recovery.

criteria.name: Vehicle, barrier and obstacle collisions
criteria.reason: No functioning vehicle/barrier/obstacle collision system.

criteria.name: Three usable race cameras
criteria.reason: No race camera implementation connected to an application.

criteria.name: Validated laps, timing, positions and finish
criteria.reason: Unused lap counters cannot establish valid finish crossings, independent laps, timings or standings.

criteria.name: Menus, HUD, instructions and interface hierarchy
criteria.reason: Static title, vehicle-selection heading and control instructions are visible; selection is empty and there is no start control, HUD or results.

criteria.name: Truthful deliverables and verification evidence
criteria.reason: No report and four captures show the same static menu instead of race views.

judgment.summary: Current entry is an infrastructure-only placeholder; displayed menu and the unconnected source modules support partial work but not gameplay.
limitations: Output-only review against public benchmark/prompts/racing_game_prompt.md A-K; elapsed time, tokens, model identity, automatic scores and GPT-assisted repairs do not contribute.
Direct saved-source inspection and reusable independent isolated build/browser evidence; no candidate code executed on host.
Limited partial credit recognizes concrete source implementation; disconnected outlines and claims do not establish usable gameplay. Completion requires the requested end-to-end playable race.

Attempt 1 uses immutable original baseline artifacts; attempts 2 and 3 use the first and second completion-pass evaluated snapshots. Manual setup updates and stale/inherited captures are excluded as gameplay proof.
